title: Thai Fish Soup
description: A flavorful and spicy Thai fish soup made with fresh fish and a variety of aromatic spices.

ingredients.name: Thai red curry paste
ingredients.notes: You can adjust the spice level to your taste

ingredients.name: Thai basil
ingredients.notes: You can use fresh or dried basil

instructions: Heat the broth in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the galangal and curry paste and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the fish and cook for 2-3 minutes, until it starts to flake.
Add the fish sauce, lime juice, and chili peppers. Stir to combine.
Simmer the soup for 5-7 minutes, until the fish is cooked through.
Season the soup with salt to taste.
Serve the soup hot, garnished with additional Thai basil if desired.
You can adjust the spice level to your taste by adding more or less chili peppers.
You can also add other ingredients, such as lemongrass or mushrooms, to the soup for added flavor.
